Class ReportPdfExporter

java.lang.Object
manager.ReportPdfExporter
public final class ReportPdfExporter extends Object
Writes report tables to a PDF without needing JavaFX or a database connection.

  • Method Details

    • export

      public static void export(File file, String title, String description, List<String> columns, List<List<String>> rows) throws IOException
      Saves a report, wrapping long cells and repeating headings on each page.
      Parameters:
      file - the destination selected by the user
      title - the report name
      description - the reporting window or report description
      columns - the displayed column headings
      rows - the displayed, formatted table values
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if columns are empty or too numerous, headings leave no room for data, or a row has a different number of cells
      IOException - if the PDF cannot be written

    • tableLines

      private static List<String> tableLines(List<String> cells, int width)
      Wraps cells into equally padded columns separated by vertical bars.
      Parameters:
      cells - cell values for one table row or heading
      width - positive character width of each column
      Returns:
      the lines needed to display the tallest wrapped cell

    • wrap

      private static List<String> wrap(String value, int width)
      Converts text to printable characters and splits it into fixed-width chunks.
      Parameters:
      value - text to wrap, or null for a dash
      width - positive maximum number of characters per line
      Returns:
      wrapped lines, with one empty line for empty text

    • printable

      private static String printable(String value)
      Replaces control characters with spaces and characters unsupported by Courier with question marks.
      Parameters:
      value - text to sanitize, or null
      Returns:
      text safe for the PDF font, or a dash for null

    • writeLine

      private static void writeLine(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream content, String text) throws IOException
      Writes sanitized text and advances to the next line of an active text block.
      Parameters:
      content - page stream with a text block and font already configured
      text - line to write
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing to the PDF stream fails
